Heir whose titles ran through Miami, Cleveland, and the Lakers.

How LeBron James connects

  • Event: NBA Finals — LeBron James's career is counted in repeated NBA Finals trips.
  • Faction: Los Angeles Lakers — LeBron James won a title in his Los Angeles Lakers chapter.
  • Faction: Miami Heat — LeBron James won two titles with the Miami Heat Big Three.
  • Event: NBA draft — LeBron James was the 2003 draft prize that remade Cleveland, then the league.

What is LeBron James?

LeBron James was the 2003 draft prize who won championships with the Miami Heat, Cleveland Cavaliers, and Los Angeles Lakers, the measuring stick of the post-Jordan era.

Key threads lead to NBA Finals, Los Angeles Lakers, Miami Heat and NBA draft.
